text:
The evidence can't answer this for 2026. The data only covers 2021 to 2025, and the latest observed year is 2025, so nothing from 2026 was evaluated.

For 2021-2025, no tree-cover loss event of 0.5 ha or more was detected on ASSET-C (374.8 ha), and valid observations covered the whole property. The property had about 43.3 ha of forest in 2020, roughly 11.55% of its area, according to the JRC reference map.

This isn't proof that nothing changed. Changes smaller than 0.5 ha, changes at edges, or changes narrower than the 30 m pixels may have been missed. The result also says nothing about regulatory compliance. A 2026 answer would need new data once the 2026 annual loss layer is released.
